# Jeremiah 16 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 16:1 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-came [the]-word-of YHWH to-me, saying: |
| LOGOS | The word of the LORD came to me: |
| PNEUMA | Then the LORD spoke to me again: |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 16:14 (overlap: 5%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "Therefore behold, days are-coming," declares YHWH, "and-it-will-not be-said again, 'As-YHWH-lives who-brought-up the-sons-of Israel from-[the]-land-of Egypt,' |
| LOGOS | "Therefore, behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when it shall no longer be said, 'As the LORD lives who brought up the people of Israel out of the land of Egypt,' |
| PNEUMA | "But the time is coming," says the LORD, "when people will no longer say, 'As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites out of Egypt.' |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

| EMET | But, 'As-YHWH-lives who-brought-up the-sons-of Israel from-[the]-land-of [the]-north and-from-all the-lands where He-had-driven-them,' and-I-will-bring-them-back to their-land which I-gave to-their-fathers." |
| LOGOS | But 'As the LORD lives who brought up the people of Israel out of the north country and out of all the countries where He had driven them.' For I will bring them back to their own land that I gave to their fathers." |
| PNEUMA | Instead they'll say, 'As surely as the LORD lives, who brought Israel back from the north and from all the countries He scattered them to.' I will bring them home to this land I gave their ancestors." |
